name: PostgreSQL
author: grandpaacademy
description: PostgreSQL database server. Place custom postgresql.conf and pg_hba.conf in /home/container/ for advanced configuration.
startup: export PGDATA=/home/container/data; export PGUSER=${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}; if [ ! -d /home/container/data ]; then mkdir -p /home/container/data; chown -R postgres:postgres /home/container/data; su - postgres -c "initdb -D /home/container/data"; echo "host all all 0.0.0.0/0 md5" >> /home/container/data/pg_hba.conf; echo "listen_addresses='*'" >> /home/container/data/postgresql.conf; echo "port = ${SERVER_PORT:-5432}" >> /home/container/data/postgresql.conf; su - postgres -c "pg_ctl -D /home/container/data start -l /home/container/logfile"; su - postgres -c "psql -c \"ALTER USER postgres PASSWORD '${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-changeme}';\""; su - postgres -c "pg_ctl -D /home/container/data stop"; fi; chown -R postgres:postgres /home/container/data; exec su - postgres -c "pg_ctl -D /home/container/data -l /home/container/logfile start -w"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# PostgreSQL Install Script
apt update
apt install -y postgresql postgresql-contrib curl jq
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo -e "install complete"
exit 0
